resume: training resume only from own registered resume state of the same suspended attempt (SRC0155); never from pilot/Task3/older freezes
budget_basis: measured t4.5-formal-r1/t4.5-init-survey-r1: reset ~24 s wall, ~24 steps/episode (random policy), VIO init failure ~13% of training instances; per seed ~850 resets*24 s + failures*(30+24) s + 20k steps -> ~30000 s; caps are limits not expectations; steps/updates/seeds/attempts/checkpoints unchanged from freeze1

actual_task_acceptance.interpretation: Engineering minimum repeated completion evidence only; not robustness, convergence or world-model benefit.

training_redraw_rule: training resets only: instance whose VIO cannot initialize within training_init_timeout_wall_s is logged and redrawn from the same RNG, at most training_vio_init_redraws_cap times; evaluation/sealed instances never redrawn and keep 120 s
training_fault_rule: training only (SRC0155): a localization fault inside an episode abandons that step (no transition stored), ends the episode and fresh-resets (<=training_localization_faults_cap_per_attempt); an infrastructure fault (sim clock stalled > liveness_clock_stall_wall_s or ROS transport failure with stalled clock) suspends the job, the stack is relaunched as a new segment (<=infrastructure_segments_cap) and training resumes from the last full trainer state saved every resume_save_interval_steps; rolled-back/abandoned interactions and updates count against explicit lost allowances; evaluation unchanged (fault = failed episode), then the campaign continues in a fresh segment
